notes.title: The Trials v1.1 is now live!
notes.content:
Happy holidays everyone! 

Here are the patch notes for the first update of [b]The Trials[/b], our game's playtest. This patch focuses on gamepad support and the addition of a new base enemy variant. 

We are currently working on a bunch of new features and improvements that will see the light during the early months of the next year. We will go into further detail in the first issue of our devlog, set to come out on January 15th.

See you in 2024, folks!

Fell Studio

[h2]The Trials 1.1 patch notes[/h2]

[h3]Updates and upgrades[/h3]
- The playtest now fully supports the use of a gamepad.
- Added a new variant of the base enemy.
- When casting a spell, the character will rotate towards the casting direction.
- The difficulties of the arena fights have been rebalanced.

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

- Fixed a bug which caused the player to remain locked onto nothing 
after finishing the fight with an enemy targeted.
- Fixed a bug which caused certain sounds from one of the fighting settings 
to be present also in the other ones.
- Removed the possibility for the player to spam-open the inventory,
possibly leading to input related issues.
- The "bulletin board" layout has been modified to fit every screen type.

notes.title: Welcome to The Trials!
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to the first playable version of the playtest for our game: The Keeper’s Book!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534642/104505af02e60b15c349ee3007a04473e620410e.png[/img]

In The Trials you will be able to test our combat system and face waves of enemies at various difficulty levels.
The build we just released is an early one, and while we know it’s lacking in features and variety, it will work as the foundation for the multiple updates we are planning for the coming months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534642/c4cda61b8727698120b1d0d4f14a1c27a22b204e.png[/img]

Our efforts for the next few patches will focus on introducing new enemies and improving the playability of the demo. The next iteration of the demo, which should be out in about a month, will support the use of a controller.

Make sure to check out our store page or our social media profiles for news and announcements regarding both the playtest and the development of the full game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44534642/1e203c204079df573ebf8c10c9edb2817ec9f567.png[/img]

We attached a small optional survey to the demo. Feel free to use it (or not) to let us know what you think about our work!

See you in the arena,

FELL Studio
